text:
zara: Heads up - ChronoAI opened dispute for INV-2026-11337: $31,420 in Dedicated overage after a multi-region failover on 2026-11-12. They flagged doubled reserved commits across eu-west and ap-southeast.
leon: I pulled the commit attribution logs. Looks like our routing service retried attribution writes to the central ledger when the ledger API timed out, and both a local flush and the retry wrote the same commit_id with different region tags.
carla-finance: rough numbers? customer wants a statement for their finance team.
matt-ops: sample sanitized lines:

```
2026-11-12T02:09:03Z,ChronoAI,eu-west,CMT-8872,commit_units=120000
2026-11-12T02:09:03Z,ChronoAI,ap-southeast,CMT-8872,commit_units=118900
2026-11-12T02:18:00Z,ChronoAI,ap-southeast,BURST,90000
```

matt-ops: duplicate commit attribution ~238,900 units. At our monthly amortized commit effective cost that maps to ~$24k; invoice overage includes other embedding/burst lines to reach $31,420.
vendor-ops: Meterly and LedgerCorp are both on the call. Meterly says their forwarder dropped ack and did a retry within our ingest window; LedgerCorp says their API responded 202 then later 500 for the same write. We're triaging cross-vendor. Ticket numbers: MTR-9022, LGC-1109.
sophie-csm: ChronoAI is mid-renewal and requested full reversal plus a 10% SLA guarantee for next quarter. They're pushing hard.
carla-finance: recommend provisional credit for vendor-responsible portion now and hold back discretionary SLA until we confirm impact. Need breakdown: vendor-recoverable vs company-absorbed goodwill.
leon: vendor-responsible portion (dedupeable events) = $24,000. Remaining disputed amount $7,420 looks like genuine burst during failover.
carla-finance: propose: (1) provisional vendor-recoverable credit $24,000; (2) optional goodwill SLA credit up to $3,000 pending senior finance signoff; (3) leave $4,420 validated. Provisional total to post = $27,000 if approved. Accounting memo: DR Revenue Adjustment 6102 $27,000 / CR Accounts Receivable 1200 $27,000.
vendor-ops: Meterly provisionally accepts responsibility for duplicate emissions but LedgerCorp is attributing partial blame to our routing retries. They're negotiating reimbursement split 70/30 Meterly/LedgerCorp.
carla-finance: we can't delay customer credit while vendors argue. We'll post the vendor-recoverable provisional credit and tag both vendor tickets. Finance will pursue recovery from vendors per vendor-recovery playbook. Also loop in Tax: if recovery comes from overseas vendor, FX and withholding apply.
tax: noted. If vendors reimburse in non-USD, we need FX gain/loss treatment on final settlement. Also withholding may apply for APAC vendors; set aside memo for tax.
leon: ops will collect event_ids and canonicalize a dedupe list to attach to vendor tickets.
sophie-csm: drafting customer message: "We identified duplicated reserved capacity attributions during your failover window. We've issued a provisional credit of $27,000 while we reconcile with our metering vendors. We'll provide final reconciliation within 14 business days. If you'd like a one-time SLA concession, we can escalate for approval."
carla-finance: approvals required: @carla-finance, @matt-ops, @zara react :thumbsup: to post provisional credit now. Also legal to review SLA language if customer accepts concession.
carla-finance: (reacts) :thumbsup:
matt-ops: (reacts) :thumbsup:
zara: (reacts) :thumbsup:
vendor-ops: LedgerCorp posted a partial admission: LGC-1109 update states they saw the 500 error and will reimburse 30% of the vendor-responsible amount. Meterly updated MTR-9022 to accept 70% responsibility and will issue credit note within 7 business days.
carla-finance: good. we'll post provisional credit and track vendor recovery tags: VendorRecovery/Meterly/MTR-9022 and VendorRecovery/LedgerCorp/LGC-1109. Finance ops note: set 21-day recovery window; after that move to write-off if unrecoverable unless escalation routes.
zara: customer replied: "Thanks for the quick action. Please prioritize final reconciliation; our renewal decision depends on it."
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-11337 status updated -> ADJUSTED (provisional credit $27,000.00) / VendorTickets: MTR-9022,LGC-1109
carla-finance: I'll post the provisional GL entries and attach reconciliation CSV. Leaving thread open until vendor reimbursements post or 21 days elapse.
